name: Basalt
description: A graphite-dark panel theme: a glass sidebar, a split sign-in card, a card dashboard with folders and favourites, a server overview and a docked console.
author: carlos

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.help: Buttons, links, the active navigation item and focus rings.

logo.label: Logo
logo.help: Shown beside the panel name in the sidebar and on the sign-in card. A square image looks best.

glass.label: Frosted sidebar
glass.help: Blur what scrolls under the sidebar and the mobile bar.

gravatar.label: Gravatar pictures
gravatar.help: Show a user's Gravatar until they upload a picture. Loading it sends a hash of their email address to Gravatar.

loginImage.label: Sign-in image
loginImage.help: The picture beside the sign-in form. Without one, the banner uses the built-in artwork.

loginTagline.label: Sign-in tagline
loginTagline.help: The line under the panel name on the sign-in banner.
loginTagline.default: Sign in to manage your servers.

loginLinks.label: Sign-in links
loginLinks.help: Extra links under the sign-in form, as Label|URL pairs separated by commas, such as: Support|https://discord.gg/example, Status|https://status.example.com

navLinks.label: Sidebar links
navLinks.help: A Links section in the sidebar, as Label|URL|icon|where entries separated by commas. The icon is any lucide name, such as message-circle, book-open or shopping-cart; where is all (the default), dashboard or server.

supportUrl.label: Support link
supportUrl.help: Where Support in the user menu leads. Leave empty to hide it.

navHeadings.label: Section headings
navHeadings.help: Group sidebar items under small headings.

welcome.label: Welcome card
welcome.help: Greet the user by name above their servers.

announcement.label: Announcement
announcement.help: A notice at the top of the dashboard. Leave empty for none. **Double asterisks** make text bold.

announcementButton.label: Announcement button
announcementButton.help: An optional button on the announcement, as Label|URL.

serverArt.label: Server artwork
serverArt.help: Show each server's egg banner behind its card. Set banners on the egg's admin page.

userAccent.label: Personal accent colour
userAccent.help: Let users pick their own accent colour on their account page. It changes the panel only for them.

languagePicker.label: Language picker
languagePicker.help: Let users choose, on their account page, which of the panel's installed languages it is shown in.

serverDashboard.label: Server dashboard
serverDashboard.help: Open a server on a dashboard of its usage, details and shortcuts, with the console on a page of its own. Off, a server opens on its console.
